name: Death Wind — a spell's X is supplied, and changing it keeps the target
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (largest remaining cluster: 'target creature gets -X/-X until end of turn', about 75 spells). addSpell never asked for X the way addPermanent does, so the literal X reached the parser and produced no effect. addSpell now takes an X value (prompt, or opts.xValue on restore), marks the spell hasXValue so the X input shows, and substitutes it via setXValue. setXValue also carries chosen targets over when the re-parse yields the same effects. Cast with X=1 at the Bears, then X is changed to 3: the Bears stay targeted and are 2/2 -3/-3.
